listing.name: inFamous (2009 PS3) (inFAMOUSreborn)
listing.summary: An early inFamous PS3 recompilation with setup 1.1. The Windows 10/11 x86-64 Direct3D 12 setup EXE checks or installs build tools, imports your own European BCES00220 ISO or game folder, then generates and compiles locally. Encrypted ISOs need their matching .dkey. A launch announcement does not establish playable progress; Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
